# Billing Problem Definition Note 1

The core problem is that billing handling of ledger interacts with installment; teams noted that invoice depends on surcharge and currency, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because billing handling of reconciliation interacts with writeoff; teams noted that payment depends on settlement and gateway, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, billing handling of payout interacts with creditnote; teams noted that subscription depends on invoiceline and refund, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that billing handling of renewal interacts with proration; teams noted that chargeback depends on tax and coupon, especially under real production load.
